messages.author: 399bf2e734c020dc
messages.subject: control.group variable
parts:
Hello,

I am applying a temporal ar1 effect controlling by region using  f(.. group= x, control.group = list(model="iid)). How do I see the parameterrs for the group iid effect, normally I would check summary.random for a regular random effect.

hyper1 = list(theta = list(prior="pc.prec", param=c(1,0.01)))

rho.hyp2<- list(prec = list(prior = "pc.prec", param = c(1, 0.01)),
                rho = list(prior = "pc.cor1", param = c(0.7, 0.7)))

  f(year.n, model="ar1", group = sand.n ,
    control.group=list(model="iid", hyper=hyper1), hyper=rho.hyp2)

Thank you,

Sylvan
